headline: President Trump signed an order creating a commission focused on military spouses.
what_it_does: This executive order sets up a new body called the President's Military Spouse Commission. No summary was provided, so details such as the commission's members, duties, and deadlines are not known from the available information. Based on the title, it is expected to focus on issues facing spouses of people serving in the military.

who_it_affects.how: The commission is expected to look at issues that affect them, though its specific tasks are not described in the available information.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed August 3, 2026; the exact effective date is not stated in the available information.
